"""Bind a concrete validation/build/link invocation to frozen source before and after."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,subprocess,time
from evidence_common import D,ROOT,sha,read,save

def verify():
    manifest=read(D/'source-identity.json')
    changed=[p for p,h in manifest['files'].items() if not (ROOT/p).is_file() or sha(ROOT/p)!=h]
    if changed: raise ValueError('Source changed: '+repr(changed))
    return {'manifestSha256':sha(D/'source-identity.json'),'archiveSha256':sha(D/'source.tar'),
            'files':len(manifest['files']),'sourceVerified':True}

def main():
    name=sys.argv[1];command=sys.argv[2:]; assert command
    before=verify(); entry={'phase':name,'command':command,'before':before,'startedUnixSeconds':time.time(),
                            'wrapperSha256':sha(Path(__file__)),'status':'running'}
    path=D/f'phase-{name}.json';assert not path.exists(),path
    save(path,entry)
    with (D/f'phase-{name}-wrapper.log').open('wb') as log:
        completed=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    entry.update(returncode=completed.returncode,finishedUnixSeconds=time.time(),
                 wrapperLogSha256=sha(D/f'phase-{name}-wrapper.log'))
    after=verify(); assert before==after
    entry.update(after=after,status='passed' if completed.returncode==0 else 'failed')
    if name.startswith('gate-'):
        (D/(name+'.exit')).write_text(str(completed.returncode),encoding='utf8')
        gate_log=D/(name+'.log')
        entry.update(gateLogSha256=sha(gate_log) if gate_log.exists() else None,
                     gateExitSha256=sha(D/(name+'.exit')))
    elif name=='release':
        entry.update(buildLogSha256=sha(D/'build-release.log'),buildExitSha256=sha(D/'build-release.exit'))
    elif name.startswith('link-'):
        _,probe,tag=name.split('-');entry.update(linkReceiptSha256=sha(D/f'identity-{probe}-{tag}.json'),
            linkLogSha256=sha(D/f'link-{probe}-{tag}.log'))
    save(path,entry); print(name,entry['status'],'frozen files',before['files'],flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(completed.returncode)

if __name__=='__main__':main()

    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as f:
        for block in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()

def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))

def save(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2), encoding='utf8')

assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain']).strip(), 'Dirty baseline'

    assert sha(ROOT / name) == digest, name
paths = sorted(set(subprocess.check_output(
    ['git', 'ls-files', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '-z']
).decode().split('\0')) - {''})
files = {}

    for name in paths:
        path = ROOT / name

        info = archive.gettarinfo(str(path), arcname=name)

"""Generate durable reports from completed receipts; never build or run probes.

No producer/auditor imports. Requires the independent audit to bind the exact
final datasets before writing the two report files. All output uses UTF-8/LF.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

D = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = D.parents[1]
TITLE = "APPEND_HISTORY_VALUEWHEN_REPAIR_20261005"
EXCLUDED = D / "valuewhen-receipts/20261005T010641.353301Z-2af843a6"
CAPACITY_ORDER = ("sma14", "sma129", "sma5000", "sma100000", "sma1000000",
                  "empty", "constant1m", "close1m", "multiClose1m")
VALUE_ORDER = ("dynamic1000", "dynamic10000", "dynamic100000", "sparse100000",
               "fixed0_100000", "fixed1_100000", "none100000", "strategy5000", "strategy20000")
HELPERS = ("capacity_probe.rs", "valuewhen_probe.rs", "capacity_runner.py",
           "valuewhen_runner.py", "evidence_common.py", "audit_append_capacity.py",
           "run_phase.py", "freeze_baseline.py", "snapshot.py", "verify_snapshot.py",
           "verify_source.py", "run_windows.ps1", "run_linux.sh", "run_targeted.ps1",
           "build_release.ps1", "link_probe.ps1", "archive_interrupted_links.py",
           "reproduce_wasm_offset.cjs", "build_report.py")


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))


def artifact(path, content=False):
    path = Path(path).resolve()
    result = {"path": path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), "sha256": sha(path),
              "bytes": path.stat().st_size}
    if content:
        result["content"] = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    return result


def write(path, text):
    Path(path).write_text(text.replace("\r\n", "\n"), encoding="utf8", newline="\n")


def fmt(value):
    return f"{value:,}" if isinstance(value, int) else f"{value:.6g}"


def transition(record):
    return f'{fmt(record["beforeMedian"])} → {fmt(record["afterMedian"])}'


def range_text(record):
    return (f'{fmt(record["beforeMin"])}–{fmt(record["beforeMax"])} → '
            f'{fmt(record["afterMin"])}–{fmt(record["afterMax"])}')


def growth_text(record):
    before, after = record["beforeMedian"], record["afterMedian"]
    return f"{(after / before - 1) * 100:+.2f}%" if before > 0 else f"基线 0，增加 {fmt(after)}"


def table(headers, rows):
    return "\n".join(["| " + " | ".join(headers) + " |",
                      "|" + "|".join("---" for _ in headers) + "|",
                      *("| " + " | ".join(str(value) for value in row) + " |" for row in rows)])


def changes(capacity, valuewhen):
    times, resources, live = [], [], []
    for case, summary in capacity["summary"].items():
        for stage, record in summary["timings"].items():
            if record["afterMedian"] > record["beforeMedian"] * 1.05:
                times.append({"probe": "capacity", "case": case, "stage": stage,
                              "field": "timing", **record})
    for case, summary in valuewhen["summary"].items():
        for stage, metrics in summary["stages"].items():
            for field, record in metrics.items():
                row = {"probe": "valuewhen", "case": case, "stage": stage, "field": field, **record}
                if field == "ms" and record["afterMedian"] > record["beforeMedian"] * 1.05:
                    times.append(row)
                elif field in {"allocatedBytes", "allocations", "peakAdditionalLiveBytes"} and record["afterMedian"] > record["beforeMedian"]:
                    resources.append(row)
                elif field == "liveDeltaBytes" and record["afterMedian"] != record["beforeMedian"]:
                    # Signed final live deltas are not a useful percentage-growth measure.
                    live.append(row)
    return {"threshold": "timing median after > before * 1.05; every positive allocation/count/peak median growth",
            "timeIncreasesOverFivePercent": times, "allAllocationOrPeakIncreases": resources,
            "allChangedSignedLiveDeltas": live,
            "interpretation": "Descriptive medians; no significance claim. Signed liveDeltaBytes is final net retained allocator-request bytes, not an isolated operation or RSS."}


def compact_dataset(dataset):
    # Keep all 3 process medians, all original repeated measurements, public
    # profiles, full bit/event oracles and locators/hashes. Omit only huge public
    # payload bytes, which remain sealed in the named local raw files.
    result = {key: value for key, value in dataset.items() if key != "records"}
    records = []
    for row in dataset["records"]:
        compact = {key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "metrics"}
        original = row["metrics"]
        compact["originalMeasurements"] = {
            key: value for key, value in original.items()
            if key not in {"seedProfile", "confirmedProfile", "finalProfile", "profile"}}
        records.append(compact)
    result["records"] = records
    return result


def audit_attempts():
    result = {}
    for path in sorted((D / "audit-attempts").glob("*/receipt.json")):
        receipt = read(path)
        archived = path.parent / "audit-results.json"
        if receipt["status"] == "passed":
            require(archived.is_file() and sha(archived) == receipt["auditResultsSha256"],
                    "Archived successful audit result differs")
        result[path.parent.name] = {**artifact(path), "receipt": receipt,
            "frozenAuditor": artifact(path.parent / "audit_append_capacity.py", content=True),
            "archivedResults": artifact(archived) if archived.is_file() else None}
    return result


def render(capacity, valuewhen, audit, delta):
    cap, val = capacity["summary"], valuewhen["summary"]
    metric = lambda case, stage, field="ms": val[case]["stages"][stage][field]
    profile = cap["sma1000000"]["timings"]["profileMedianPerCallNs"]
    forming = metric("dynamic100000", "formingWithoutOutput")
    lines = ["# 历史容量与 valuewhen 检查点修复（2026-10-05）", "",
        "修复两处随历史长度增长的开销，并修正 wasm32 对超大 occurrence 的整数截断。"
        f"本机受控样本中，百万窗口的 public profile 从 {fmt(profile['beforeMedian'] / 1000)} → {fmt(profile['afterMedian'] / 1000)} µs/次，"
        f"十万事件的 forming 无输出更新从 {transition(forming)} ms。收益属于这些 API 和输入，不能换算为解释器整体加速倍数。", "",
        f"基线 `{audit['source']['baseCommit']}`；冻结基线 {audit['source']['beforeFiles']} 份源码和 {audit['source']['baselineCompilerArtifacts']} 份编译产物，"
        f"最终 {audit['source']['afterFiles']} 份源码用于两平台完整门禁、release 构建和探针链接。本轮源码与测试共修改/新增 11 个文件；本报告两文件在门禁后生成，不在该源码快照中。", "",

"""Seal the clean 2688c13b1 source and all link dependencies before editing."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import io
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import tarfile

ROOT = Path.cwd()
D = ROOT / '.local/append-capacity-20261004'
PRIOR = ROOT / '.local/parser-copy-20261004'
D.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as f:
        for block in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()

def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))

def save(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2), encoding='utf8')

assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain']).strip(), 'Dirty baseline'
base = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).decode().strip()
assert base == '2688c13b1f24e335b30c55883dc4d523c848d98e'
compiled = read(PRIOR / 'source-identity.json')
link = read(PRIOR / 'identity-capacity-after.json')
for name, digest in link['libraryHashes'].items():
    assert sha(ROOT / name) == digest, name
paths = sorted(set(subprocess.check_output(
    ['git', 'ls-files', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '-z']
).decode().split('\0')) - {''})
files = {}
with tarfile.open(D / 'before-source.tar', 'w') as archive:
    for name in paths:
        path = ROOT / name
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        data = path.read_bytes()
        files[name] = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        info = archive.gettarinfo(str(path), arcname=name)
        if name.endswith('.sh'):
            info.mode = 0o755
        archive.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(data))
assert all(files.get(name) == digest for name, digest in compiled['files'].items())
save(D / 'before-source-identity.json', {'base_commit': base, 'files': files})
libraries = {}
sources = [p for p in sorted((ROOT / 'target/release/deps').iterdir())
           if p.is_file() and p.suffix in {'.rlib', '.dll', '.lib', '.rmeta'}]
sources += [ROOT / 'target/release' / name for name in
            ['libpine_runtime.rlib', 'libpine_sema.rlib', 'libpine_syntax.rlib']]
for source in sources:
    relative = source.relative_to(ROOT / 'target/release')
    target = D / 'baseline' / relative
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    digest = sha(source)
    shutil.copy2(source, target)
    assert sha(target) == digest
    libraries[str(source.relative_to(ROOT))] = {
        'archive': str(target.relative_to(ROOT)), 'sha256': digest,
    }
for name, digest in link['libraryHashes'].items():
    assert sha(ROOT / name) == digest == libraries[name]['sha256'], name
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain']).strip(), 'Source edited during freeze'
save(D / 'before-binary-identity.json', {
    'baseCommit': base,
    'beforeManifestSha256': sha(D / 'before-source-identity.json'),
    'beforeArchiveSha256': sha(D / 'before-source.tar'),
    'compiledPriorManifest': str((PRIOR / 'source-identity.json').relative_to(ROOT)),
    'compiledPriorManifestSha256': sha(PRIOR / 'source-identity.json'),
    'compiledPriorFiles': len(compiled['files']),
    'compiledPriorIsUnchangedSubsetOfBaseline': True,
    'priorLinkReceipt': str((PRIOR / 'identity-capacity-after.json').relative_to(ROOT)),
    'priorLinkReceiptSha256': sha(PRIOR / 'identity-capacity-after.json'),
    'libraries': libraries,
    'method': 'All rlib/proc-macro DLL/import-lib/rmeta sealed before edits/builds; primary libraries match prior audited final link',
})
print('Frozen', len(files), 'baseline source files and', len(libraries), 'link objects at', base, flush=True)
